rate_limits.correction: Customer API: 10 requests/second and 8 concurrent requests per API user; publication endpoints are limited to 2 requests/second, and some endpoints have stricter concurrency limits.

notes: The API and documentation are current and operational, but the rate-limit claim is false because official limits are published. API-key authentication is supported via X-SmartToken, although OAuth 2.0 is also supported and recommended for many production integrations. CORS policy was not documented in the official sources located.
